requirements.text: Session-start authorization ('This is the new season start up the 3 loops'): the orchestrator executes the seq-122 handoff's recorded relaunch drill for ALL THREE supervised lanes now — per lane: diagnose the 12:43-12:45Z stop from the run's audit triple (events/context_tokens/observed_models, never the S14 string), deny every stale pending ask in BOTH stores (CLI pending-approvals store and the durable-journal ask store), clear-recovery to PREFLIGHT, set a fresh run-id in the lane's launcher ACTIVE-TASK block (61->62 m5t060, 24->25 m5t058, 07->08 m5t061), relaunch via C:\SupervisorController{,2,3}\autostart-launch.ps1 — and re-arm the read-only loop watcher (scratchpad/loop_watcher.py under a persistent Monitor).
